PTFE Film
PTFE, also known as polytetrafluoroethylene, is a synthetic high-molecular-weight material. It has an extremely low surface energy,  化工, high and low temperature resistance, electrical insulation and non-stick properties.As the "King of Plastics" ,PTFE has widespread 应用行业页 in various fields of the national economy, including 化工, pharmaceutical, food, mechanical, electronic, electrical, military, 航空, environmental protection, and bridge construction.
Material characteristics
Chemical Resistance
01
PTFE is inert to almost all 化工s and resists attack by strong acids, bases, organic solvents and oxidants over a wide temperature range (-250°C to +260°C).
01
Non-stick Property
02
Due to its low surface energy, PTFE surface is very smooth and not easily adhered to by other substances, which makes it widely used in non-stick pans, pipe linings, seals and other fields.
02
Heat Resistance
03
PTFE can maintain its physical and 化工 properties at high temperatures, has a very high melting point (about 327°C) and excellent the heat resistance.
03
Electrical Insulating Property
04
PTFE is an excellent insulating material with extremely high resistivity and extremely low dielectric constant, suitable for electrical and electronic 应用行业页 domain.
04
Low Friction
05
PTFE has an extremely low coefficient of friction, the smallest of all plastics, which makes it a wide range of 应用行业页 in lubrication and friction reduction.
05
Insulation Property
06
PTFE is an excellent insulating material and can be used for wire and cable
The insulation layer.
06

Natural Color

PTFE casting film VB-3 is used as the vacuum bagging film. It is recommended for high temperature cure cycles where a good softness and drapability are required.
PTFE Ultra-high temperature Vacuum Bagging Film
Teflon tape is made of a PTFE film coated with a heat-resistant silicon pressure-sensitive adhesive. The PTFE substrate used for this tape has high tensile strength and excellent wear resistance, while retaining the excellent release property of PTFE itself.

Q
Do you provide samples for testing before large-scale purchase?
A：Yes. We offer sample films so clients can test performance in their specific pharmaceutical 应用行业页.
Q
How do your films perform under high-speed sealing and cutting operations?
A：Our films withstand high-speed sealing and cutting, providing consistent quality without tearing or sticking.
Q
Can your films be used in conjunction with protective overwraps or secondary packaging?
A：Yes. Our films are compatible with additional layers without compromising release or barrier properties.
Q
Are your films resistant to repeated folding and unfolding during packaging?
A：No. Our films maintain flexibility and do not crack or deform under repeated handling.
Q
Do you provide technical support for integrating your films into production lines?
A：Yes. We offer guidance and support to ensure smooth integration into pharmaceutical packaging systems.
Q
How long can your films maintain performance under continuous high-temperature operations?
A：Our films are designed for long-term high-temperature stability, maintaining integrity throughout extended production runs.
Q
Can your films prevent cross-contamination in multi-product production lines?
A：Yes. Their barrier properties and smooth release surface help minimize cross-contamination risks.
Q
Are your films compliant with international pharmaceutical regulations?
A：Yes. Our films meet major regulatory standards such as USP Class VI and ISO guidelines.
Q
Can your films be customized for unusual shapes or complex packaging formats?
A：Yes. We offer custom cutting and die-cutting to match complex pharmaceutical packaging designs.
Q
Can your films support multilayer pharmaceutical packaging systems?
A：Yes. They integrate well into multilayer systems without compromising barrier or release properties.
Q
How do your films perform in high-speed pharmaceutical filling lines?
A：Our films are engineered for high-speed lines, providing consistent release without jamming or sticking.
Q
Can your films withstand mechanical folding or bending during packaging?
A：Yes. They are flexible and resist cracking, maintaining performance even after bending.

The film releases cleanly after curing at temperatures up to 260°C and pressures up to 10 bar (typical autoclave conditions). It leaves no residue on carbon fiber or glass fiber parts.
  • QWhat industries most commonly use your high-temperature release film, and why?
    A：Key industries include: 电子 manufacturing (wave soldering, conformal coating masking), composite manufacturing (autoclave and press curing), food processing equipment (non-stick conveyor belts and baking molds), packaging (heat sealing jaws), and 航空 (pre-preg lay-up and vacuum bagging). In all cases, the film must survive process temperatures while releasing cleanly without contaminating the product.
  • QWhat types of adhesive are used in your release film tapes, and what are the bonding differences?
    A：Our PTFE tapes use silicone pressure-sensitive adhesive (PSA), which maintains adhesion and release properties across the full temperature range (-70°C to +260°C). Our ETFE-EC tape uses acrylic PSA, which is preferred for moderate temperature 应用行业页 (up to 165°C) where longer-term bonding strength is more important than ultra-high-temp performance.
  • QWhat thicknesses are available for your PTFE release films, and how do I choose the right one?
    A：We offer four main PTFE tape configurations: HSM 22S (100μm or 80μm), HM 32S (110μm), and HM 52S (160μm). Thinner films (80–100μm) are used where conformability and close contact are needed; thicker films (110–160μm) offer longer service life in repeated-use press operations. We recommend discussing your cycle counts and pressure parameters.
  • QWhat is the maximum continuous operating temperature of your high-temperature release film?
    A：Our PTFE-based release films withstand continuous operation at +260°C (500°F) and can tolerate short-term peaks up to +280°C. ETFE-EC variants operate continuously at -150°C to +165°C. PET-based variants have a maximum of 204°C. The choice depends on your process requirements.
  • QWhat is a high-temperature release film and what materials are typically used in your product?
    A：A high-temperature release film is a specialty film coated with release agents (typically silicone or fluoropolymer) that prevents adhesion at elevated temperatures. Our product line uses PTFE (Teflon) film as the primary substrate, offering release properties from -70°C to +260°C. We also offer ETFE-EC variants with acrylic adhesive for specific bonding 应用行业页.
  • QHow does ETFE compare to FEP film for wire and cable insulation 应用行业页?
    A：ETFE has higher tensile strength (48MPa vs. FEP's ~24MPa) and better abrasion resistance, making it preferred for wire and cable jacketing in 航空 and military 应用行业页 where mechanical durability is critical. FEP offers slightly better 化工 resistance and lower friction. ETFE is preferred where mechanical toughness matters most.
  • QWhat is the anti-static or ESD performance of ETFE in 电子 manufacturing environments?
    A：Standard ETFE is an excellent electrical insulator (surface resistivity >10¹⁶ Ω/sq), which can present ESD risks in 电子 manufacturing. We offer antistatic-treated or carbon-loaded ETFE grades with surface resistivity in the 10⁶–10⁹ Ω/sq range, suitable for ESD-sensitive assembly lines and component packaging.
  • QCan ETFE film withstand 化工 exposure common in 半导体 fabs (HF, sulfuric acid, solvents)?
    A：ETFE demonstrates excellent resistance to hydrofluoric acid (HF), sulfuric acid, nitric acid, and most organic solvents — substances that attack many other plastics and metals. It is widely used in 半导体 wet processing equipment, 化工 handling lines, and cleanroom 应用行业页. Chemical compatibility charts are available.
  • QWhat is the dielectric constant of ETFE, and is it suitable for high-frequency PCB 应用行业页?
    A：ETFE has a dielectric constant of approximately 2.6–2.8 at 1MHz and remains stable across a wide frequency range. This low, stable dielectric constant makes ETFE suitable for high-frequency microwave PCB substrates, antenna insulation layers, and radar equipment. We can provide dielectric property data sheets for design engineers.
  • QDo you supply ETFE in roll or sheet format, and what are the standard roll lengths?
    A：ETFE is available in roll format as standard. Roll lengths depend on thickness and width — typically 100–500 linear meters per roll, with each roll weighing approximately 10–15kg. Sheet cutting is available for custom dimensions. We can discuss specific roll configurations based on your processing needs.
  • QCan ETFE film be used for flexible 电子 and wearable device substrates?
    A：ETFE is gaining attention in flexible 电子 due to its electrical insulation, flexibility, and 化工 resistance. It is used as a substrate for flexible circuits and piezoelectric sensors, and as encapsulation for wearable 电子. Its biocompatibility also makes it suitable for 医药 wearables. Custom thin gauges (down to 12μm) are available.
  • QHow does ETFE's thermal insulation compare to glass in 建材 envelopes?
    A：Single-layer ETFE has a U-value similar to single-pane glass (~5.7 W/m²K). However, multi-layer ETFE cushion systems with trapped air layers achieve U-values of 1.5–2.0 W/m²K, comparable to double-pane low-E glass. Four-layer cushions can achieve U-values below 1.0 W/m²K, offering excellent thermal performance.
  • QWhat is the expected weathering lifespan of your ETFE film under outdoor UV exposure?
    A：Our ETFE film maintains its optical and mechanical properties for over 25 years of outdoor exposure. We conduct accelerated weathering tests equivalent to 30+ years using xenon arc chambers. ETFE does not yellow, crack, or delaminate under prolonged UV exposure. Long-term performance data is available upon request.
  • QCan perforated ETFE film be supplied, and what are the typical 应用行业页?
    A：Yes, we offer ETFE with custom perforation patterns. Perforated ETFE is used in acoustic panels (sound absorption while maintaining transparency), ventilated façades, air distribution systems in greenhouses, and filtration media. Hole size, pitch, and pattern can be customized to meet airflow or acoustic requirements.
  • QWhat quality inspection processes do you use for ETFE film production?
    A：Every production run undergoes online defect detection using optical inspection systems, thickness measurement with in-line gauges, and melt flow index testing. Pre-shipment checks include tensile strength, elongation, transmittance, and surface energy tests. We maintain full batch traceability and provide CoA (Certificate of Analysis) with every shipment.
  • QCan ETFE film be printed with solar cell patterns for BIPV (Building Integrated Photovoltaics)?
    A：Yes, ETFE is an ideal substrate for BIPV 应用行业页. It can receive screen-printed, inkjet-printed, or sputtered photovoltaic cell patterns and conductive inks. Its transparency allows for semi-transparent BIPV panels that double as architectural glazing. We can supply treated ETFE ready for PV processing.
  • QHow does ETFE film behave in fire, and what fire ratings does it achieve?
    A：ETFE is inherently flame-retardant without additives — it has a limiting oxygen index (LOI) above 30%, meaning it does not sustain combustion in normal air. Upon ignition, it self-extinguishes and does not drip burning material. It meets UL94 V-0 rating and satisfies European fire class B-s1,d0 requirements for many 建材 应用行业页.
  • QWhat certifications does your ETFE film hold (UL, RoHS, REACH, etc.)?
    A：Our ETFE film holds UL certification and passes HF (halogen-free flame) and SGS testing. Products are RoHS compliant and meet REACH SVHC substance requirements. Additional certifications such as IATF 16949 (automotive) and AS9100 (航空) are available for specific product lines.
  • QDoes your ETFE film meet food contact and pharmaceutical purity standards?
    A：Our ETFE film is produced without plasticizers or additives, making it compliant with FDA 21 CFR regulations for food contact and suitable for pharmaceutical 应用行业页. It has excellent 化工 inertness and will not leach compounds into food or drug 产品页. Documentation for compliance is available upon request.
  • QCan ETFE film be laminated with other materials for composite 应用行业页?
    A：Yes, ETFE can be laminated with metals (aluminum, copper), textiles, foams, and other films. Surface treatment (plasma or 化工 etching) is required first to enhance adhesion. We supply ETFE pre-treated and ready for lamination, and can collaborate on composite development projects.
  • QWhat is the minimum order quantity for ETFE film, and what is the typical lead time?
    A：Minimum order quantities vary by specification. Standard 产品页 (common thicknesses and widths) typically have an MOQ of 100kg. Custom specifications may require higher minimums. Standard lead time is 2–4 weeks; custom orders may require 4–8 weeks. Please contact our sales team for specific quotations.
  • QIs ETFE recyclable, and what is its environmental footprint compared to glass?
    A：ETFE is fully recyclable — it can be melted down and reprocessed into new film. Its production energy is significantly lower than glass per unit area (ETFE weighs ~350g/m² vs. 25kg/m² for glass). The longevity of ETFE further reduces lifecycle environmental impact. We are aligned with circular economy principles.
  • QHow does ETFE perform in 航空 and satellite 应用行业页?
    A：ETFE's resistance to radiation, extreme temperature cycling (-70°C to +150°C), and vacuum conditions make it highly suitable for 航空 wiring insulation, flexible solar array substrates, and thermal blankets. It holds AS9100 certification eligibility and passes outgassing tests per ASTM E595 standard.
  • QWhat is the self-cleaning mechanism of ETFE, and does it require any maintenance?
    A：ETFE has an extremely low surface energy (~31 mN/m), which causes water to bead and roll off, carrying dust particles away. Rain is typically sufficient to keep ETFE surfaces clean. In heavily polluted urban environments, occasional washing with water is recommended. No 化工 cleaners are needed.
  • QWhat is the tensile strength and elongation of your ETFE film, and how does it handle wind loading?
    A：Our ETFE has a tensile strength of 48 MPa and elongation at break of 300%. For wind loading in architectural 应用行业页, ETFE cushion systems are designed to be pre-stressed — the pneumatic inflation pressure is adjusted so the film carries loads through tension rather than bending. Engineering support for load calculations is available.
  • QCan ETFE film be used for agricultural greenhouse covering, and what are its advantages over PE film?
    A：ETFE is an excellent greenhouse material. It outperforms standard PE film in several ways: lifespan exceeds 20 years (vs. 1–3 years for PE), it maintains transmittance without yellowing, is 化工ly resistant to pesticides and fertilizers, and is fully recyclable. While the upfront cost is higher, the long-term ROI is significantly superior.
  • QWhat color options are available for ETFE film, and are printed patterns possible?
    A：We offer ETFE in transparent, white, frosted (matte), red, blue, and with dot-pattern (frit) printing. Custom colors and printed patterns — including branding, gradients, and decorative motifs — are available for architectural and design 应用行业页. Minimum order quantities apply for custom prints.
  • QHow does ETFE compare to PVDF film for use as a solar panel front sheet?
    A：ETFE offers higher light transmittance (>90% vs. ~88% for PVDF), greater flexibility, and superior weathering resistance over 25+ years. PVDF is more cost-effective and easier to thermoform. For high-efficiency flexible modules, ETFE is preferred; for conventional rigid panels requiring easy processing, PVDF is often chosen.
  • QIs your ETFE film certified for use in photovoltaic solar panels, and what are the relevant standards?
    A：Our ETFE film meets key PV industry requirements including IEC 61215, IEC 61730, and UL certifications. It passes PCT accelerated aging tests and damp-heat tests (85°C/85% RH for 1,000 hours). ETFE is widely used as front-sheet material for flexible and bifacial solar modules.
  • QWhat surface treatments do you offer for ETFE, and when is plasma or 化工 etching recommended?
    A：We offer plasma treatment and 化工 etching (sodium etching) for ETFE. Plasma treatment is recommended for bonding, printing, or lamination 应用行业页. Chemical etching creates a micro-rough surface that significantly enhances adhesion — ideal for structural composites or when applying pressure-sensitive adhesives.
  • QCan ETFE film be heat-welded on-site, and what equipment is required?
    A：Yes, ETFE is fully heat-weldable using standard hot-air welding or wedge-welding machines. No special solvents are required. Our technical team can provide welding parameter guidelines (temperature range 250–280°C, speed settings) and on-request training support for fabricators.
  • QHow does ETFE perform in extreme cold climates, such as Nordic countries or Canada?
    A：ETFE retains excellent flexibility and mechanical strength at temperatures as low as -70°C, making it suitable for Arctic and sub-Arctic climates. Its elongation at break remains at 300%, preventing cracking. The material does not become brittle in freezing conditions, unlike many alternatives.
  • QWhat is the certified light transmittance of your ETFE film, and does it affect UV filtration?
    A：Our ETFE film achieves over 92% light transmittance (HP/AG grades). ETFE naturally blocks short-wave UV below 200nm; mid-range UV (280–380nm) is partly transmitted. For 应用行业页 requiring controlled UV filtering — such as greenhouses or museums — we can add UV-blocking coatings or additives.
  • QWhat thicknesses and widths does your ETFE film come in, and can you customize dimensions?
    A：Our standard ETFE film ranges from 12µm to 500µm in thickness. Standard width reaches 1,600mm, with custom widths up to 2,100mm available. We support full customization of thickness, width, length, and color to match your project specifications.
  • QWhat is ETFE film and how does it differ from traditional glass or polycarbonate in construction?
    A：ETFE (Ethylene Tetrafluoroethylene) is a fluoropolymer film known for its exceptional transparency (>92%), light weight (1% of glass), and tensile strength. Unlike glass, ETFE can be formed into pneumatic cushion structures, is self-cleaning, and has a lifespan exceeding 25 years. Compared to polycarbonate, it offers superior UV resistance and does not yellow over time.
  • QHow does ETFE compare to FEP film in terms of weight?
    A：In specific release and technical 应用行业页, our ETFE MR (Release Grade) film is 20% lighter per unit area than FEP film, which can reduce the overall structural load of your project.
  • QWhy is ETFE considered a "self-cleaning" material?
    A：Thanks to its low coefficient of friction and non-stick properties, the film exhibits a "Lotus Effect". Dust and dirt do not easily adhere to the surface and are typically washed away by natural rainfall.
  • QDo you offer different finishes or colors for specific agricultural needs?
    A：Yes. Our ETFE AG (Architectural/Agricultural Grade) series comes in transparent, matte, white, and blue. We also offer functional variants such as UV-blocking or Infrared-blocking versions to optimize the growing environment.
  • QCan the film be bonded to other materials or frames?
    A：Yes. We provide specialized surface treatments, including plasma treatment and 化工 etching, to create bondable surfaces for complex composite 应用行业页 or frame attachments.
  • QWhat thicknesses and widths are available for international orders?
    A：We offer a versatile range of thicknesses from 12µm to 500µm. While our standard maximum width is 2100mm, we can slit the film to any width based on specific customer requirements.
  • QDoes the film absorb water or 化工s used in farming?
    A：No. Our ETFE film has an extremely low water absorption rate of <0.03% and is 化工ly inert to most 化工s and solvents used in agricultural processes.
  • QWhat are the mechanical strengths of your film regarding wind and hail resistance?
    A：Our film is engineered for durability. It has a tensile strength of 48 MPa and a high elongation at break of 300%. This flexibility allows it to absorb impacts from hail or withstand high wind loads without tearing.
  • QHow does ETFE handle extreme temperatures in different climates?
    A：VitaFlon® ETFE offers excellent resistance to both high and low temperatures. Its long-term stable working temperature ranges from -80°C to 165°C, and it can withstand peak temperatures up to 230°C.
  • QWhat is the light transmission rate of your ETFE film for agricultural use?
    A：Our ETFE film provides exceptional optical clarity with a solar light transmission rate exceeding 95% (tested via ASTM E424). It maintains high transmittance (over 95%) across the ultraviolet (UV) and far-infrared spectrums.
  • QWhat is the 化工 composition of PLUSXTECH ETFE film?
    A：Our VitaFlon® ETFE is a melt-extruded film made from 100% ethylene-tetrafluoroethylene copolymer resin. It offers the superior properties of fluoropolymers, such as heat weldability and 化工 inertness, without any mixed plastics or additives.
  • QWhy can ETFE film be utilized for roofing in construction?
    A：ETFE film is a durable and lightweight film 产品页, its weight is about 1% of the weight of the glass. 92% high light transmission can effectively use natural light, easy to make the 家装 full of light.Strong weather resistance, corrosion resistance, and flame retardant properties ensure outdoor use for approximately 30 years. The non-adhesive surface maintains a clean and beautiful appearance at all times, reducing the cost of cleaning and maintenance.
  • QWhat are the advantages of FEP film?
    A：FEP film has excellent weather resistance, corrosion resistance,dielectric properties and outstanding insulation properties,which is currently used in a variety of electrical insulation parts.Through the material modification upgrade and satisfying different needs of customers, PLUSXTECH enhances the corresponding product performance, expands the scope of use of FEP film in different scenarios.
  • QWhat is the difference between PLUSXTECH polymer film and other film on the market?
    A：PLUSXTECH has the independent R&D center, which can modify and upgrade the raw materials. The excellent production technology allows our film to be produced without adding other solvents,ensuring that the 产品页 contain high purity and the maximum energy efficiency is brought into full play in every application scenario.

If you have any questions, comments or suggestions about the contents of this Privacy Policy, want to change the scope of your authorization to collect and use personal information, or terminate your authorization, you can contact our Customer Service Center by sending an email to marketing@plusxtech.com.

Technology Empowering Agriculture: An In-Depth Analysis of the Five Key Technical Advantages of the FlexFlon® ETFE AG Series Films
Release time：2026-04-13

Introduction: The Revolution in Covering Materials for Protected Agriculture
In high-end protected 农业, the performance of greenhouse covering materials directly determines crop photosynthetic efficiency, greenhouse environmental stability and the long-term operational costs of farms. PLUSXTECH' FlexFlon
®
ETFE AG Series fluorocarbon films, with their unique molecular structure, deliver exceptional solutions for modern 农业 across five key dimensions.
1. Superior Weather Resistance: 20-Year Quality Guarantee
Traditional polyethylene (PE) or polyolefin (PO) films typically yellow and become brittle within 1-3 years under the combined effects of UV radiation and extreme temperature cycles.
Technical Advantage
FlexFlon
®
agricultural films feature ultra-strong C-F 化工 bonds, which provide inherent UV resistance and excellent high/low temperature tolerance.
Application Value
They retain their physical properties unchanged after thousands of hours of extreme weather testing, transforming greenhouse coverings from "annual consumables" into "long-term production assets" and drastically reducing the labor and material costs associated with frequent film replacement.
2. Exceptional Self-Cleaning: Consistent Light Transmission Assurance
Dust accumulation is the primary cause of reduced greenhouse light transmittance, and manual cleaning is not only time-consuming but also risks scratching the film.
Technical Advantage
This series of films has an extremely low surface energy and an exceptionally dense, smooth surface, making it difficult for dust and impurities to adhere.
Application Value
Thanks to the "lotus effect", ordinary rainfall can wash away surface dust to achieve self-cleaning. This ensures the film maintains a high light transmittance of over 92% throughout its entire service life, allowing crops to receive sufficient sunlight at all times.
3. High-Efficiency Anti-Fogging & Anti-Dripping: Scientifically Create a Dry Greenhouse Environment
Condensed water droplets that fall on leaf surfaces can easily trigger fungal infections and cause light scattering.
Technical Advantage
FlexFlon
®
agricultural films are treated with a special anti-dripping process, which causes condensed water to form a continuous thin film that flows down the surface instead of forming falling droplets.
Application Value
It effectively reduces greenhouse humidity and fundamentally prevents the occurrence of diseases such as botrytis cinerea and late blight. This not only improves crop appearance but also reduces the frequency of pesticide application.
Note: The original text mentions "灰尘病", which is a common typo for "灰霉病 (botrytis cinerea)", the standard agricultural disease term.
4. Precise UV Blocking: Physical Barrier for Production Safety
Excessive UV radiation not only accelerates the aging of greenhouse equipment but also disrupts the growth rhythm of certain crops.
Technical Advantage
Our films effectively filter out harmful UV wavelengths, extending the service life of irrigation systems, shading equipment and related sensors inside the greenhouse.
Application Value
This physical barrier also interferes with the visual navigation of certain pests such as thrips, providing auxiliary physical pest control and creating a cleaner growing environment.
5. Optimised Infrared Transmittance: Intelligent Greenhouse Thermal Balance Regulation
Drastic temperature fluctuations are the main cause of crop stress.
Technical Advantage
Through fine-tuning of the light spectrum, FlexFlon
®
agricultural films optimise infrared transmittance, helping greenhouses suppress overheating during the day and reduce ground heat loss at night.
Application Value
It stabilises day-night temperature differences and provides a more stable growth microclimate for crops, thereby shortening growth cycles and increasing overall yield.
PLUSXTECH: Dedicated to the Perfect Integration of Materials Science and Agriculture

Traditional polyethylene (PE) or polyolefin (PO) films typically yellow and become brittle within 1-3 years under the combined effects of UV radiation and extreme temperature cycles.

Technical Advantage

FlexFlon® agricultural films feature ultra-strong C-F 化工 bonds, which provide inherent UV resistance and excellent high/low temperature tolerance.

Application Value

They retain their physical properties unchanged after thousands of hours of extreme weather testing, transforming greenhouse coverings from "annual consumables" into "long-term production assets" and drastically reducing the labor and material costs associated with frequent film replacement.

2. Exceptional Self-Cleaning: Consistent Light Transmission Assurance

Dust accumulation is the primary cause of reduced greenhouse light transmittance, and manual cleaning is not only time-consuming but also risks scratching the film.

Technical Advantage

This series of films has an extremely low surface energy and an exceptionally dense, smooth surface, making it difficult for dust and impurities to adhere.

Application Value

Thanks to the "lotus effect", ordinary rainfall can wash away surface dust to achieve self-cleaning. This ensures the film maintains a high light transmittance of over 92% throughout its entire service life, allowing crops to receive sufficient sunlight at all times.

3. High-Efficiency Anti-Fogging & Anti-Dripping: Scientifically Create a Dry Greenhouse Environment

Condensed water droplets that fall on leaf surfaces can easily trigger fungal infections and cause light scattering.

Technical Advantage

FlexFlon® agricultural films are treated with a special anti-dripping process, which causes condensed water to form a continuous thin film that flows down the surface instead of forming falling droplets.

Application Value

It effectively reduces greenhouse humidity and fundamentally prevents the occurrence of diseases such as botrytis cinerea and late blight. This not only improves crop appearance but also reduces the frequency of pesticide application.

Technical Advantage

This physical barrier also interferes with the visual navigation of certain pests such as thrips, providing auxiliary physical pest control and creating a cleaner growing environment.

Drastic temperature fluctuations are the main cause of crop stress.

Technical Advantage

Through fine-tuning of the light spectrum, FlexFlon® agricultural films optimise infrared transmittance, helping greenhouses suppress overheating during the day and reduce ground heat loss at night.

Application Value

It stabilises day-night temperature differences and provides a more stable growth microclimate for crops, thereby shortening growth cycles and increasing overall yield.

Why has the VitaFlon® MR Series Release Film become the go-to choice for the high-end manufacturing industry?
Release time：2026-03-30
Number of views：

In the 航空, 半导体 and high-end 电子 sectors, release film is a critical auxiliary material that directly determines product yield, reliability and surface performance. As manufacturing processes evolve toward higher precision, higher pressure and extreme temperature conditions, conventional film materials can no longer meet the requirements of these complex application scenarios. Leveraging the atomic-level structural advantages of fluoropolymers, the VitaFlon
®
MR Series Release Film (including ETFE, FEP, PFA, PTFE and other grades) from Zhengyu New Materials is emerging as a core driver for high-end domestic substitution of release films in China.
1. Aerospace: Conformability and Zero Contamination in Extreme Environments
During the vacuum forming of carbon fiber composite parts, conventional films are prone to bridging, which causes uneven stress distribution, and tend to outgas small molecules at high temperatures that contaminate the prepreg.
Superior Vacuum Conformability: VitaFlon
®
ETFE features an ultra-high elongation at break of 300%-500%. It conforms to complex curved surfaces such as wing leading edges and S-shaped air inlets like a "second skin", completely eliminating wrinkles.
Aerospace-Grade Low Outgassing: It delivers an extremely low Total Mass Loss (TML) in high-temperature vacuum environments, eliminating the migration of volatile condensables into the resin matrix at the source and safeguarding the fundamental mechanical properties of composites.
2. Semiconductor Packaging: Dimensional Stability and Clean Release
In advanced packaging processes, temperatures above 180°C can easily cause film deformation and lead to chip tunneling defects, while the tensile force during demolding poses a high risk of damaging low-k dielectric layers.
High-Temperature Rigid Support: It maintains exceptional dimensional accuracy under packaging process temperatures, acting as a "rigid temporary mold skin" to precisely lock the chip position and fully eliminate flash defects.
Nanoscale Lawn-Effect Release: It leverages its inherent low surface energy to achieve drag-free demolding, enabling residue-free, stress-free release between dense solder balls and micro-circuits, and significantly improving product yield.
3. High-End Electronics: Performance Backing for Flexible and Ultra-High-Frequency Applications
For flexible printed circuit (FPC) lamination and high-frequency copper clad laminate (CCL) manufacturing, release films must withstand multiple process cycles without interfering with the dielectric properties of the end product.
Exceptional Electrical Isolation: It has an ultra-low dielectric constant (Dk) and dissipation factor (Df), introducing no additional interfering factors and supporting stable transmission of 5G/6G high-frequency signals.
Voltage Resistance and Anti-Blocking Performance: With outstanding 化工 resistance and long-lasting release properties, it ensures no blocking or residue after repeated lamination cycles, effectively reducing production costs.
Conclusion
Release films have evolved from ordinary consumables into strategic industrial materials. Backed by internationally authoritative management system certifications including AS9100, Zhengyu New Materials is accelerating the delivery of reliable domestic substitution solutions in critical sectors such as 航空 and 半导体s.

PCTFE Film
PCTFE film is a melt-extruded cast film made from PCTFE resin (polychlorotrifluoroethylene).It exhibits excellent gas barrier properties and superior electrical insulation.Additionally,it has good optical properties,mechanical strength,and 化工 resistance.PCTFE film is widely used in fields such as packaging,化工 engineering,医药,electrical and electronic,vacuum technology,and optics.
Material characteristics
Weather Resistance
01
The material has good weather resistance.Exposure to outdoor sunlight for one year has no impact on its performance.
01
Electrical Insulation
02
The dielectric constant and dielectric loss factor are relatively low over a wide range of frequencies.The material exhibits excellent electrical properties,such as high insulation resistance and high dielectric breakdown voltage,and is virtually unaffected by temperature or humidity.It is a high-frequency insulating material.
02
Chemical Inertness
03
The high fluorine content of PCTFE makes it resistant to almost all 化工s and oxidizing agents.It can remain unchanged even after prolonged immersion in acids,bases,or oxidizers.However,it can be corroded by molten alkali metals,elemental fluorine,and chlorine trifluoride at high temperatures.Additionally,it may swell when in contact with benzene and its homologues,as well as polyhalogenated compounds,under high-temperature conditions.
03
Hydrophobicity
04
Among all plastics,PCTFE has the lowest water vapor permeability.It is impermeable to any gases and serves as an excellent barrier polymer.
04
Mechanical Properties
05
The mechanical properties at room temperature are superior to those of Polytetrafluoroethylene(PTFE).It has high compressive strength,low creep,and a high compression recovery rate,exhibiting good elastic recovery.However,the mechanical properties are significantly affected by temperature and can vary depending on the degree of crystallinity and molecular weight.
05
Temperature Resistance
06
The material can operate stably over a long-term temperature range of-196°C to 130°C,with a maximum temperature capability up to 212°C.
06

In the 半导体 packaging process, ETFE is recognized as the most commonly used release film in the industry. Film assisted forming (FAM) is a key process in modern integrated circuit manufacturing. In this process, ETFE film reduces the stripping force when the IC is removed from the mold, and the mold does not need to be inspected or cleaned between injection shots, so it is used to increase the yield and productivity of the machine.
Practical application case:
For example, the well-known Apple wearable device Apple Watch, its powerful S9 chip integrated the entire computer architecture, including application processor, panel display, Wi-Fi, NFC, power management and other subsystems, through the stacked staggered SiP technology package integration. ETFE film plays a crucial role in the packaging process.
ETFE 半导体 film advantages:
1
.N
on-stick properties
:
ETFE 半导体 film can meet the requirements of maintaining non-adhesive energy at high temperature, low surface energy, will not pollute the mold and copper foil, and the surface is clean and pollution-free after release, which is a good release film for high temperature composite material molding.
2
.H
igh temperature extension:
High heat resistance, in the wide continuous use temperature range of -200 ° C to 165 ° C (-328 ° F to 330 ° F), ETFE film has superior release performance and flexibility, with high elongation and excellent fit softness, to meet the needs of different shapes of molds, and is widely used in complex molds.
High tensile and tear strength at high temperatures, which can effectively avoid film breakage and play a protective buffer role-by reducing the impact of solid sheet and mantle/overflow, you can prevent IC chip damage; Soften the impact during forming and prevent PKG of the ceramic substrate from being damaged.

elf-cleaning: low surface tension is not easily contaminated with dirt and easy to clean
Due to the extremely small size of 半导体s, even the slightest contamination can impair their performance, and keeping the microchip clean during the manufacturing process is essential to reduce potential contamination or damage caused by micro-impurities.
Semiconductor manufacturing involves ultra-high purity 化工s and solvents, and ETFE film reduces the release force required to remove molded integrated circuits from the mold, provides a wrinkle-free surface after molding, no impurity precipitation, does not contaminate the mold and copper foil, and is a good release film for high temperature composite molding.

.C
hemical corrosion resistance: acid, alkali, 化工 agents and other harsh conditions
In the 半导体 manufacturing process, such as wafer cleaning, etching, etc., a large number of electronic gases or 化工s are used, most of these materials are highly corrosive, so the pipeline, pump valve, storage container and other components or lining materials used for 交通ation and storage are required to have outstanding 化工 corrosion resistance and low precipitation.
ETFE film ensures that highly corrosive 化工s in the chip manufacturing process do not contaminate ultra-clean environments.

In the 半导体 packaging process, ETFE is recognized as the most commonly used release film in the industry. Film assisted forming (FAM) is a key process in modern integrated circuit manufacturing. In this process, ETFE film reduces the stripping force when the IC is removed from the mold, and the mold does not need to be inspected or cleaned between injection shots, so it is used to increase the yield and productivity of the machine.

Practical application case:

 

For example, the well-known Apple wearable device Apple Watch, its powerful S9 chip integrated the entire computer architecture, including application processor, panel display, Wi-Fi, NFC, power management and other subsystems, through the stacked staggered SiP technology package integration. ETFE 半导体 film advantages:

1.Non-stick properties:

ETFE 半导体 film can meet the requirements of maintaining non-adhesive energy at high temperature, low surface energy, will not pollute the mold and copper foil, and the surface is clean and pollution-free after release, which is a good release film for high temperature composite material molding.

 

2.High temperature extension:

High heat resistance, in the wide continuous use temperature range of -200 ° C to 165 ° C (-328 ° F to 330 ° F), ETFE film has superior release performance and flexibility, with high elongation and excellent fit softness, to meet the needs of different shapes of molds, and is widely used in complex molds.

 

High tensile and tear strength at high temperatures, which can effectively avoid film breakage and play a protective buffer role-by reducing the impact of solid sheet and mantle/overflow, you can prevent IC chip damage; Soften the impact during forming and prevent PKG of the ceramic substrate from being damaged.

 

3.Self-cleaning: low surface tension is not easily contaminated with dirt and easy to clean

Semiconductor manufacturing involves ultra-high purity 化工s and solvents, and ETFE film reduces the release force required to remove molded integrated circuits from the mold, provides a wrinkle-free surface after molding, no impurity precipitation, does not contaminate the mold and copper foil, and is a good release film for high temperature composite molding.

 

4.Chemical corrosion resistance: acid, alkali, 化工 agents and other harsh conditions

In the 半导体 manufacturing process, such as wafer cleaning, etching, etc., a large number of electronic gases or 化工s are used, most of these materials are highly corrosive, so the pipeline, pump valve, storage container and other components or lining materials used for 交通ation and storage are required to have outstanding 化工 corrosion resistance and low precipitation.

ETFE film ensures that highly corrosive 化工s in the chip manufacturing process do not contaminate ultra-clean environments.

 

5.Customization:

Application of ETFE film in the field of architecture
Release time：2023-11-30
Number of views：
people
The field of architecture is constantly striving for innovation and excellence, and a variety of new 建材 materials are constantly emerging, providing designers and engineers with more options. Among them, ETFE film as a high performance, environmental protection and a high degree of design freedom of 建材 materials,attracts more and more people's attention.
Basic properties of ETFE film
ETFE film is a polymer material composed of ethylene and tetrafluoroethylene copolymerization. It has many excellent properties, such as high strength, high-heat resistance, high 化工 resistance, high pollution resistance and easy cleaning. These characteristics make ETFE film have a wide application prospects in the field of construction.
Chemical stability:
ETFE film has a high degree of 化工 stability and can resist the erosion of most 化工 substances, including acids, bases, salts and so on. This allows ETFE films to maintain stable performance under various environmental conditions.
Excellent heat resistance:
ETFE film has high heat resistance and can maintain its physical properties and mechanical properties at high temperatures. In the field of construction, ETFE film can withstand a variety of extreme weather tests, such as high temperature, sun exposure, rain and so on.
High strength and tensile properties:
ETFE film has high strength and tensile properties, and can withstand greater pressure and tension. This allows ETFE films to maintain their stability and durability when making large structures.
Good self-cleaning performance:
ETFE film surface has low adhesion, making it easy to clean. Rain washes away dirt from the surface and keeps it clean at all times. In addition, ETFE film also has the ability to self-repair, even if there are some scratches or damage, it can also repair itself in a short time.
Good climate adaptability:
ETFE film has good climate adaptability and can maintain stable performance under different climatic conditions. Whether it is high temperature, low temperature, wet or dry environment, ETFE membrane can adapt and maintain good performance.
Environmental sustainability:
ETFE film can be recycled, in line with the concept of environmental sustainable development. By recycling waste ETFE film, the consumption of natural resources can be reduced, and the pollution to the environment can be reduced.
The application of ETFE film in the field of construction
Roofing material
ETFE film is widely used in various roofing materials because of its excellent heat and 化工 resistance. It can be combined with the base material by hot melting or bonding to form a robust roofing system. This material not only has excellent waterproof performance, but also can effectively resist the invasion of natural disasters.
Curtain wall material
ETFE film has high transparency and good light transmission, so it is also widely used in various curtain wall materials. It can be combined with other materials such as laminated glass or insulating glass to form a curtain wall system with excellent thermal insulation and energy saving performance. This material is not only beautiful, but also can effectively improve the energy efficiency of 建材s.
Pneumatic pillow
ETFE film can also be made into air pillows, used in various 建材 structures. The air pillow is an adaptive structure that can automatically adjust its shape and size according to changes in external loads. In the field of architecture, air pillows are widely used in a variety of structures requiring large-span space, such as stadiums, exhibition centers and so on. By using the air pillow made of ETFE film, the efficiency and quality of the 建材 structure can be effectively improved.
With the continuous improvement of people's requirements for 建材 quality and aesthetic degree, ETFE film as a new type of 建材 material will be more and more widely used. At the same time, with the continuous progress of science and technology and the continuous improvement of application technology, the performance and application fields of ETFE film materials will continue to expand.
Therefore, we have reason to believe that ETFE membrane will become a new star in the future construction field.

In the kingdom of plastics, there is a striking family-fluoroplastics. They are known for their excellent performance and wide range of 应用行业页.
Each member of this family has his own talents, his own strengths, They are polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), polyperfluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP), polytrifluoroethylene chloride (PCTFE), polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), meltable polytetrafluoroethylene (PFA), ethylene-tetrafluoroethylene copolymer (ETFE), tetrafluoroethylene-hexafluoropropylene-vinylidene fluoride copolymer (THV), and polyfluoroethylene (PVF).
1. PTFE
PTFE is a crystalline polymer prepared by free radical polymerization of tetrafluoroethylene, melting point 327℃, melting viscosity is very large, 380℃ up to 1010Pa·s, not easy to form processing, density of 2.13 ~ 2.19 g/cubic centimeter. PTFE has excellent 化工 resistance, a dielectric constant of 2.1, a low loss factor, and is stable over a wide range of temperatures and frequencies. In addition, PTFE's coefficient of friction is almost lower than any other material, with a high oxygen index (OI), limiting oxygen index (LOI) up to 95%, can prevent the spread of flame, but also has excellent weather resistance, low friction coefficient, from low temperatures to 392 ° C can be used. PTFE can be made into pellets for extrusion and molding, powders for fluidized beds and electrostatic finishes, and water dispersions. PTFE semi-finished 产品页 have film, plate, rod and single fiber, which is mainly used to make pipes and 化工 equipment, drum surface layer and various wires and cables, such as aircraft hook wire, pressurization cable, alarm cable, flat cable and oil well logging cable. PTFE film has been used as a thin coating for solar collectors.
2. FEP
FEP is a crystalline polymer composed of tetrafluoroethylene and hexafluoropropylene. FEP crystals have a melting point of 304 ° C and a density of 2.15 g/cm ³. It is a soft plastic with lower tensile strength, wear resistance and creep resistance than many engineering plastics. FEP is a 化工ly inert material with a low dielectric constant (2.1) over a wide range of temperatures and frequencies. The material does not ignite, the oxygen index is up to 95%, can prevent the spread of flame, but also has excellent weather resistance, low friction coefficient, from low temperature to 392℃ can be used. The material can be made into pellets for molding and extrusion, the film thickness is 0.0254mm ~ 0.254mm, and it can also be made into rods and tubes.
3. PCTFE
PCTFE is a linear backbone polymer of repeating units polymerized by trifluorochloroethylene free radical. PCTFE is a crystalline polymer with a melting point of 217 ° C and a density of 2.13 g/cm ³. PCTFE is inert to most active 化工s at room temperature, and can be dissolved by a few solvents above 212 ° C, and can also be swollen by some solvents. PCTFE has excellent gas barrier ability, and the water vapor permeability of its film 产品页 is the lowest in all transparent plastic films. The electrical properties of PCTFE are similar to those of other perfluoropolymers, but the dielectric constant and loss factor are slightly higher, especially at high frequencies. PCTFE can make thick (3.175mm) optical transparent parts, can be made into molded and extruded granules, made of film thickness 0.0254mm ~ 0.254mm, can also be made into rods and tubes.
4. PVDF
PVDF refers to the homopolymer of vinylidene fluoride (VDF) or the copolymer of VDF and a small amount of fluorinated vinyl-monomer, which increases the melt bonding and decreases the viscosity of the solution, while the performance is almost unchanged compared with polytetrafluoroethylene. The long-term use temperature of PVDF is -80℃ -260 ℃, has excellent 化工 resistance, is one of the lowest friction coefficient of plastics, and has good electrical properties, its electrical insulation is not affected by temperature. PVDF is suitable for the production of corrosion resistant parts, wear resistant parts, seals, insulation parts and 医药 equipment parts, but also for high temperature wire, cable insulation, anti-corrosion equipment, sealing materials, pump valve bushings and 化工 containers.
5. ETFE
ETFE is the strongest fluorine plastic, while maintaining the good heat resistance, 化工 resistance and electrical insulation properties of polytetrafluoroethylene, its radiation resistance and mechanical properties have been greatly improved, the tensile strength can reach 50MPa, close to twice of polytetrafluoroethylene, more importantly, its processing properties can be greatly improved. In particular, its adhesion to the metal surface is outstanding, so that the tight lining process of fluorine plastics and steel can be truly realized.
ETFE also has excellent optical transparency and low refractive index, which can allow the penetration of all frequencies of light from ultraviolet to infrared, and is ideal for plastic optical fiber coating due to its low refractive index and high flexibility. In addition, ETFE fluoroplastics have excellent 化工 resistance and excellent penetration resistance to many corrosive 化工s. In addition, ETFE is easy to bond, and it is also easy to bond with other materials, and it can be bonded well with other materials without surface treatment. Its good solubility can be achieved by adding 化工 reagents to achieve 化工 foaming and other characteristics.
Due to its many excellent properties, new uses of ETFE are constantly being developed, such as fuel control, safety glass, wire and cable, blow molding 产品页, light control and so on. With scientific progress and development, ETFE has a wide range of 应用行业页, and has begun to be applied to solar cell membranes, 建材 membranes, flexible 化工 storage tank pipelines, 化工 reaction pipelines and transmission pipelines with corrosive liquid flow, flexible polymer hoses and containers for special fields.
6. PFA
PFA is a copolymer of ethylene and tetrafluoroethylene, with good heat resistance, 化工 resistance, oxidation resistance and electrical insulation properties of polytetrafluoroethylene, and has good processing properties. PFA can produce corrosion resistant parts, wear resistant parts, seals, insulation parts and 医药 equipment parts, but also can be used for high temperature wire, cable insulation, anti-corrosion equipment, sealing materials, pump valve bushings and 化工 containers.
The above is the introduction of several main 产品页 and their advantages in the fluorine plastics family. These fluoroplastics have a wide range of application prospects in their respective fields, bringing convenience to our lives and industrial production.
With the continuous development of science and technology, it is believed that there will be more new fluoroplastic 产品页 in the future, bringing more possibilities to our lives and industrial production.

The development of solar cells and the ingenious application of ETFE film
Release time：2023-11-30
Number of views：
people
ETFE film, also known as ethylene-tetrafluoroethylene copolymer, is a transparent film material with no fabric substrate. Its elongation can reach 420% ~ 440%, and the light transmission spectrum is similar to that of glass, so it is also known as soft glass.
ETFE film have excellent properties, including good 化工 stability, corrosion resistance and excellent weather resistance.
As the global attention to renewable energy continues to increase, the development and application of solar cells are also getting more and more attention. In order to make better use of solar energy resources, improve the power generation efficiency and reduce the cost of solar cells, flexible solar cells have become a research hotspot. The successful development of this new type of solar cell is inseparable from the key protection material - ETFE film.
Compared with traditional solar cells, flexible solar cells have the characteristics of softness and flexibility, so that they can adapt to more application scenarios. One of the key materials that makes such solar cells possible is ETFE film. It can not only provide good protection for solar cells, but also has the advantages of high light transmittance, lightweight, impact resistance and so on.
So, how does ETFE film achieve high light transmittance?
First,
its 化工 structure gives it a high transmittance in the visible light range. In addition, during the manufacturing process, ETFE film has high surface smoothness and low porosity, while providing excellent dust and water resistance. These properties make ETFE film have high transmittance in the visible light range, while also blocking ultraviolet and infrared rays.
In order to further improve the light transmittance of ETFE film, anti-reflection coating can be plated on the surface of the film, which can reduce the reflection of light, thereby improving the light transmittance of the film.
In addition to high light transmittance, ETFE film has excellent impact resistance. Compared to glass, ETFE film is very soft and will not break due to impact. This characteristic makes flexible solar cells safer and more reliable during use. In addition, ETFE film also has the advantages of excellent pollution resistance and light weight, making the design and carrying of solar cells more flexible and convenient.
In short, ETFE film, as an excellent protective material, plays a key role in the development and application of flexible solar cells.
Its high light transmittance,
impact resistance, dirt resistance and lightweight characteristics make flexible solar cells more efficient, safe and reliable. With the continuous progress of technology and the increasing market demand, ETFE film will play a more important role in the future energy field.
In the future, as the global demand for renewable energy continues to increase, the development prospects of flexible solar cells will also be broader.
As a key material for flexible solar cells, the demand and application of ETFE film will continue to expand. Therefore, the research and development of new varieties of ETFE film, new processes and new application areas will bring more extensive development space and opportunities for the future energy field.
At the same time, we also need to continue to pay attention to and research other new solar cell technologies to better meet human needs for clean energy and promote sustainable development.

Thickness and quality:
The thickness of ETFE film is usually between 0.105 and 0.125 mm. With the increase of thickness, the film will be harder and more brittle, difficult to process. Fireproof
performance:

Tensile
strength
:

Stress-strain relation: When the tensile stress is below 20 MPa at normal temperature, the ETFE film has complete elastic properties, and the tensile modulus reaches 800 ~ 1,000 MPa; When the tensile stress is near 25 MPa, there will be a yield point, and then it will enter the plastic strengthening stage until it breaks.
Elongation
at break:

In the manufacture of optical components, ETFE film is widely used due to its transparency and 化工 resistance.
With the continuous progress of science and technology, the requirements for material performance in the electronic 半导体 industry are also increasing.

Application of ETFE film in planting greenhouse and agricultural greenhouse
Release time：2023-11-30

people
There is no doubt that ETFE film is an excellent material for greenhouses.
In addition to being used in large 建材s - for example, the Bird's Nest, the main venue of the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games, and the Water Cube, the swimming pool - ETFE film is also widely used in agricultural fields, such as animal husbandry, breeding, and greenhouses for growing flowers, vegetables, and fruits.
There are two main types of greenhouses that use ETFE film, one is botanical gardens, zoos, and the other is agricultural greenhouses.
ETFE agricultural film for greenhouse
In 1997, ETFE film was the covering material used in the farm greenhouse in Changping District of Beijing. The greenhouse mainly raised and planted Japanese muskmelon, strawberry and colored bell pepper.
Because of its full-band optical fiber transmission, ETFE film is especially conducive to infrared absorption of plants, so as to offset low-temperature radiation at night and help crop growth. In Japan, almost all planting greenhouses will use ETFE film.
In 2001, the United Kingdom established the world's largest ETFE film structure 建材 - Eden greenhouse, which brings together almost all the plants in the world, more than 4,500 species, 134,000 flowers and trees, the greenhouse is composed of four dome-like 建材s connected, covered with ETFE transparent film structure cover plate, it can improve the survival efficiency of rare plants.
ETFE agricultural film advantages
1.high light transmittance
Compared to other traditional materials such as glass, acrylic or polyethylene, ETFE film combines the total transmittance of direct and diffuse light, resulting in a higher transmittance of 90-95%, whether single or double, providing more transmittance even in the absence of sunlight, and protecting against UV radiation harmful to plants. Keep plants healthy and safe.
2.Low maintenance cost
ETFE film has non-viscous surface characteristics, dirt, dust and debris will not adhere to it, and will be washed away by rain, so as to achieve self-cleaning effect, reducing the time and cost of cleaning and enclosure. In addition, snow and ice on the film is also easy to slip, so in the cold winter can also bring more light to the room, with a high cost performance.
3.long service life
Strong resistance to ultraviolet radiation, coupled with excellent self-cleaning ability, makes the service life of ETFE film is 8 times that of traditional polyethylene covering, long-term exposure to environmental pollution, ultraviolet light, harsh 化工s or extreme temperature changes for more than 25 years, ETFE film will not appear any signs of deterioration and performance decline.
4.high tensile strength
Although ETFE film is elastic, it is still structurally resistant, flexible and tough, helping to reduce the impact of strong winds and protect the greenhouse structure.
5.strong self-healing ability
ETFE film has an amazing self-healing ability to restore a dent caused by rubble or hail in just a few hours, or even less, and it does not fail in extreme climates.
6.excellent fire resistance
The flame retardant rating of ETFE film is B1, the highest rating in the industry, and if a fire occurs, it will play a self-extinguishing and flame retardant characteristics to avoid the spread of fire in the greenhouse.

ETFE film: This high-tech material you may not know is changing our lives
Release time：2023-11-30
Number of views：
people
People are under the impression that the roof of the house is made of extremely hard material to keep us safe, but have you ever seen a soft roof? Compared to traditional materials, this material is light and flexible, transparent and environmentally friendly, let's learn about this amazing material: ETFE film material.
Exploring the mysteries of ETFE film: How can its properties change our lives?
Why are the tops of some houses made of such soft materials? ETFE 建材 film has many properties that other 建材 materials cannot match:
ETFE film can resist temperature changes, can be exposed to the temperature of -200℃~+150℃,
while maintaining the good heat resistance, 化工 resistance and electrical insulation properties, its radiation resistance, mechanical properties and processing properties have been greatly improved, this film material has strong corrosion resistance.
It can also maintain 化工 stability in the long-term sun and precipitation environment, and its service life can be as long as 15-25 years, and it can also form a unique shape, which is environmentally friendly, economical and beautiful.
ETFE film has a strong self-cleaning ability
, the unique anti-adhesion surface makes it have high pollution resistance, usually rain can remove the main dirt, not only reduces the frequency of cleaning but also reduces the cost of maintenance, can be used as a recyclable material, can be produced into other ETFE 产品页 after separation of impurities.
ETFE film has excellent corrosion resistance to acids, bases, 化工s and most solvents, maintaining material integrity in harsh environments.
It is not only resistant to corrosion but also can be combined with metal materials, the unique strong adhesion characteristics of metal, close to the linear expansion coefficient of carbon steel, with excellent negative pressure resistance characteristics.
New choice for green 建材: ETFE 建材 film, opening a new chapter in environmentally friendly new materials
ETFE film structures are widely used in construction fields, such as stadiums, exhibition centers, landscape coverings, etc. Its transparency makes the 家装 space more bright and open, while also achieving energy saving effects.
In addition, ETFE film can also adjust the air pressure to achieve the opening and closing function, providing a controllable ventilation effect. It has the ability to reliably adjust the environmental conditions inside the 建材 through UV transparency, can print specific patterns and control the sunlight conditions in layers, and can also light individual MATS with color-changing leds to create unique patterns, thus allowing the 建材 facade to reflect the 家装.
In Guangzhou South Railway Station and the main stadium of Dalian Sports Center, the Regional Transportation Center in Anaheim, California, the United States, and the Shed Art Center in New York, the United States, ETFE film is widely used.
Shed Art Center in New York uses a movable shell of ETFE film structure covered on the 8-story main 建材. When the shell is moved out, it covers the open square in front of it and increases the temporary performance or exhibition space of about 1600m². This design highlight fully reflects the material advantages of ETFE film, such as light weight and good light transmission.
Unlike plastics, which can be hazardous to health,
ETFE film is both easy to recycle and durable, cost-effective to produce and have low energy consumption during manufacturing and 交通ation,
thanks in large part to their light weight. Due to its elasticity, ETFE film performs well in natural disasters and is self-extinguishing in the event of a fire.
With the increasing attention of people to environmental problems, ecological energy saving has become an important concept of architectural design. Green 建材, as an important part, should pay attention to sustainable development and create a better living environment for people.
ETFE 建材 film material with its excellent material characteristics, will become the mainstream film material in the market, its development prospects are considerable, the market potential is huge, facing a good development opportunity.

ETFE film: The ideal material for flexible photovoltaic cell packaging
Release time：2023-11-18
Number of views：
people
With the increasing demand for renewable energy, the technology of solar energy and photovoltaic industry has been continuously developed, the materials of photovoltaic solar panels are also constantly updated, and in recent years, ETFE materials have been used by more and more solar panel manufacturers. ETFE is a high performance polymer material with excellent physical and 化工 properties.
In solar panel manufacturing, ETFE is considered to be the ideal packaging material for flexible photovoltaic cells and the best choice as a backplane material for solar panels.
ETFE membrane, the invisible champion in the field of solar energy
Compared with traditional solar cells, ETFE film as a solar backplane material has many advantages.
First,
the ETFE film itself is lighter, which can reduce the weight of solar panels and manufacturing and 交通ation costs. This makes the solar panels made with it more lightweight and easy to carry, suitable for outdoor activities and field work.
Secondly,
ETFE material has good impact resistance and heat resistance. At different temperatures, ETFE materials will not be destroyed, and can resist external impact or bending to a certain extent to reduce the breakage rate of solar panels, thus greatly improving the service life of solar panels.
Thus, solar panels manufactured with ETFE can maintain their structural integrity under high temperature conditions.
The field of ETFE membrane photovoltaic has demonstrated its skills, and the new energy revolution has quietly emerged.
In the application of flexible photovoltaic cells, ETFE materials are also one of the most promising research directions in recent years. Compared with most PV backplanes on the market that use PVDF and PVF as the outer fluorine film, ETFE materials have excellent durability and weather resistance, and can withstand extreme temperature and climate conditions, thereby extending the service life of solar panels.
In contrast, traditional solar panel materials such as glass or aluminum alloy have relatively low durability and weather resistance, and are easily damaged by environmental factors.
As the ideal packaging material for flexible photovoltaic cells, ETFE film can get rid of tempered glass, has strong adhesion characteristics unique to metal, overcome the non-adhesion defect of PTFE to metal, close to the linear expansion coefficient of carbon steel, and become an ideal composite material for metal, so that photovoltaic modules become from the upper ETFE film, EVA layer, battery layer, etc.
The EVA layer and the lower ETFE layer are composed of five layers, so that the thickness of the battery is only less than 1mm. Because it is completely made of plastic, its weight is only 1kg/ square meter, which truly realizes flexibility and portability. Flexible solar panels are expected to be rapidly applied in 航空, solar cars, solar sailing ships, outdoor activities and disaster emergency and many other scenarios with high requirements for lightweight, portability and application, making it possible for solar energy to be made into any shape and attached to any object surface.
With the continuous innovation of technology and the continuous improvement of market demand, ETFE film will play an increasingly important role in the solar energy and photovoltaic industry, and with the continuous development and improvement of ETFE materials, its performance and application range in solar panel manufacturing will continue to improve and expand.
In the future, we expect ETFE membranes to bring more technological innovation and market development in these areas.

Superior performance of ETFE
Light transmission and heat preservation
ETFE has extremely high light transmittance, which can maximize the use of solar energy and improve the sunshine efficiency of the greenhouse. At the same time, ETFE also has excellent thermal insulation performance, which can effectively maintain the appropriate temperature in the greenhouse and reduce energy consumption.
Light and easy to install

In addition, ETFE is self-healing and can repair itself at room temperature even if damage occurs.
Flame retardant and environmental protection
ETFE has excellent flame retardant properties, no dripping after hot melt, and has a good inhibition effect on the spread of fire. In addition, ETFE is an environmentally friendly material that can be recycled and reused, reducing pollution to the environment.
The excellent performance of ETFE in greenhouses is understood, which provides the best conditions for the production of greenhouses. So, in practical 应用行业页, how does ETFE help optimize and upgrade the greenhouse?
Greenhouse covering material

At the same time, the light and easy installation characteristics of ETFE also make the construction of greenhouse more convenient and quick.

Sustainable 农业
As a recyclable and environmentally friendly material, ETFE is in line with the development trend of sustainable 农业. The use of ETFE can reduce the impact on the environment while improving the sustainability and economic efficiency of agricultural production.
The application of ETFE in the field of greenhouse has many advantages and potential. Its unique properties can meet the high requirements of modern 农业 for light transmission, heat preservation, environmental protection and sustainability.
With the continuous progress of technology and the continuous expansion of 应用行业页, ETFE will play a more important role in the future greenhouse field.
